digest.component_or_area: LLM runner execution and settings extraction
propositions: extract build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits() from runner.py into structured_run.py as pure functions with explicit parameters (no side effects)
build_usage_limits() must return a 3-tuple (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) because eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the UsageLimits object due to max() being non-invertible
cache_settings must be passed as a parameter to build_model_settings() to preserve the model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path
build_model_settings() must perform no side effects; the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation stays inline in run() and the leaf-invariant test must pass with no runtime import from runner
structured_run.py must remain between 100 and 500 LOC after extraction; runner.py must drop from 699 to under 700 LOC as machine-enforced by test_runner_regains_real_headroom_under_the_cap
all monkeypatch targets that move must be repointed in the same commit; seam guard hardcoded lists must include both new function names to assert something about them
